entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:1
segments: ¶"At the end of [every] seven years you shall grant a release [of debts].

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:2
segments: "And this [is] the form of the release: Every creditor who has lent [anything] to his neighbor shall release [it]; he shall not require [it] of his neighbor or his brother, because it is called the LORD'S release.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:3
segments: "Of a foreigner you may require [it]; but you shall give up your claim to what is owed by your brother,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:4
segments: "except when there may be no poor among you; for the LORD will greatly bless you in the land which the LORD your God is giving you to possess [as] an inheritance-

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:5
segments: "only if you carefully obey the voice of the LORD your God, to observe with care all these commandments which I command you today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:6
segments: "For the LORD your God will bless you just as He promised you; you shall lend to many nations, but you shall not borrow; you shall reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:7
segments: "If there is among you a poor man of your brethren, within any of the gates in your land which the LORD your God is giving you, you shall not harden your heart nor shut your hand from your poor brother,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:8
segments: "but you shall open your hand wide to him and willingly lend him sufficient for his need, whatever he needs.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:9
segments: "Beware lest there be a wicked thought in your heart, saying, 'The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand,' and your eye be evil against your poor brother and you give him nothing, and he cry out to the LORD against you, and it become sin among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:10
segments: "You shall surely give to him, and your heart should not be grieved when you give to him, because for this thing the LORD your God will bless you in all your works and in all to which you put your hand.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:11
segments: "For the poor will never cease from the land; therefore I command you, saying, 'You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor and your needy, in your land.'

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:12
segments: ¶"If your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:13
segments: "And when you send him away free from you, you shall not let him go away empty-handed;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:14
segments: "you shall supply him liberally from your flock, from your threshing floor, and from your winepress. [From what] the LORD has blessed you with, you shall give to him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:15
segments: "You shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; therefore I command you this thing today.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:16
segments: "And if it happens that he says to you, 'I will not go away from you,' because he loves you and your house, since he prospers with you,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:17
segments: "then you shall take an awl and thrust [it] through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:18
segments: "It shall not seem hard to you when you send him away free from you; for he has been worth a double hired servant in serving you six years. Then the LORD your God will bless you in all that you do.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:19
segments: ¶"All the firstborn males that come from your herd and your flock you shall sanctify to the LORD your God; you shall do no work with the firstborn of your herd, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:20
segments: "You and your household shall eat [it] before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD chooses.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:21
segments: "But if there is a defect in it, [if it is] lame or blind [or has] any serious defect, you shall not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:22
segments: "You may eat it within your gates; the unclean and the clean [person] alike [may eat it], as [if it were] a gazelle or a deer.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 15:23
segments: "Only you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it on the ground like water.
